name: Taho Pharmaceuticals Ltd.
summary: Taho Pharmaceuticals Ltd., a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, focuses on the development of drug delivery systems in transdermal and transmucosal systems in Taiwan. The company offers TAH4411 Ondansetron ODF, a selective serotonin 5HT3 receptor antagonist for the treatment of chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting. Its pipeline includes TAH3311 Apixaban oral film, which is in phase III; TAH3341, an anticoagulant apixaban ODF extended-release film, which is in preclinical stage.
